name: dsh-ui-state
description: UI state that outlives the process, for the vn-harness Web GUI and its desktop window alike. One host-owned settings namespace (`vn-harness` in $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml) holds the state a reload would otherwise forget - the page zoom, an extension theme (Nord/Monokai, which the shipped durable preference schema cannot hold), the terminal dock's height and open state, and the left/right column widths - and one browser half binds that namespace once, restores the two column widths into ui-layout's own store, and publishes the `uiState` client service the pack's other halves write their own fields through. It is host-side on purpose: localStorage is per browser profile, so a Chrome tab and the desktop window's WebView can never share it, while a settings section is one picture both hosts read. Alpha.
